title: Internship Anti Money Laundering & Sanctions
description:
Descrizione azienda

Mediobanca è un affermato operatore finanziario specializzato, attivo nel Wealth Management, nel Corporate & Investment Banking e nel Consumer Finance, che gode di una reputazione incontrastata sul mercato italiano, consolidata dal riconosciuto approccio responsabile al business, dall’elevata professionalità delle nostre persone e dall’eccellenza dei servizi offerti.


Posizione

Il/la tirocinante, inserito/a nella Funzione Antiriciclaggio Mediobanca, si occuperà di supportare il team Governance, Estero & Financial Sanctions nella gestione degli adempimenti antiriciclaggio, contrasto al finanziamento del terrorismo e misure restrittive. In particolare il/la tirocinante supporterà il team nelle seguenti attività: - identificazione, analisi e valutazione impatti della nuova normativa in materie di misure restrittive; - svolgimento di verifiche in materia di misure restrittive; - coordinamento e oversight società controllate.


Requisiti

Competenze specialistiche e informatiche

Ottima conoscenza di Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese.

Laurea in materie giuridiche, economiche o discipline affini.

Caratteristiche personali

Buone capacità di comunicazione; ottime capacità di pianificazione ed organizzazione del lavoro per priorità; proattività; capacità di lavorare in squadra; capacità di lavorare sotto stress; capacità analitiche; spirito critico; problem solving


Altre informazioni

Richiesta disponibilità immediata.

Per la posizione di stage è previsto un rimborso spese mensile di 1000 euro lordi.

Per le aziende di Mediobanca la diversità e l’inclusività sono valori fondamentali. Le persone interessate verranno considerate nel rispetto della diversità, valorizzando differenti caratteristiche di età, cultura, abilità e orientamento o espressione di genere.

title: Internship Data Quality Analyst/Data Scientist
description:
Descrizione azienda

Mediobanca is an established, specialized financial operator operating in Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking and Consumer Finance, with an unparalleled reputation in the Italian market, consolidated by an acknowledged responsible approach to banking, the high professionalism of staff, and the excellence of the services offer.


Posizione

The Data Quality Analyst/Data Scientist is a position reporting to Chief Data Officer (CDO).

The intern will support the team for shaping and executing the delivery of data quality program following the Data Governance guidelines and will support the CDO in designing the data quality framework and the data owners and data stewards in its implementation.

He/She will also work on the enhancement of the value of financial business-related data by applying data-driven methodologies.

More specifically, the intern will:

  • support data owners and data stewards to implement data quality framework within their data domain;
  • collaborate with the data owners to create and maintain data quality dashboards and issues log;
  • monitor data quality dashboards and issues log and creating reports on data quality;
  • ensure appropriate action is taken in case of data quality issues;
  • collect, examine, and analyze large amounts of financial data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities useful for informed investment strategies and business decisions to be taken;
  • utilize advanced statistical methods to develop models for the implementation of business cases;
  • create customized tools and algorithms to automate complex processes, enhance efficiency and provide innovative solutions for business needs.


Requisiti

We are looking for motivated interns with a Master Degree in a quantitative or business area, such as Finance, Accounting, Mathematics or Engineering.

The main skills required are as follows:

  • knowledge of best practices in data governance, methodologies and tools;
  • understanding of data related architecture, integration, classification strategy, quality management, security and privacy standards;
  • understanding of data analytics in complex environments;
  • knowledge of statistical methodologies, modeling techniques, and machine learning algorithms;
  • programming skills, particularly in languages such as Python, R and one query language like SQL;
  • excellent relationship management;

For the six months internship, participants will receive a gross monthly allowance of €1,000.


Altre informazioni

Diversity & Inclusion are core values for Mediobanca. All applications are welcome; we value age, background, ability, personal orientation and gender expression diversity.

title: Internship - Financial Engineering AI Team
description:
Descrizione azienda

Mediobanca è un affermato operatore finanziario specializzato, attivo nel Wealth Management, nel Corporate & Investment Banking e nel Consumer Finance, che gode di una reputazione incontrastata sul mercato italiano, consolidata dal riconosciuto approccio responsabile al business, dall’elevata professionalità delle nostre persone e dall’eccellenza dei servizi offerti.


Posizione

The candidate will join the Financial Engineering AI team within the Front Office area of Mediobanca.

The internship will focus on the development of AI-powered solutions for financial markets, with particular emphasis on Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI frameworks, knowledge retrieval systems, and workflow automation.

The successful candidate will contribute to the design and development of an AI platform supporting traders, structurers, sales teams and quantitative analysts. Activities will span from building AI agents and integrating LLMs into existing systems to developing tools for knowledge management, market intelligence, code analysis, and automation of financial workflows.

The role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Quantitative Finance and Software Engineering, gaining exposure to real-world applications of advanced AI technologies in an investment banking environment.


Requisiti

General Requirements

  • A college degree / master in STEM (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Data Science) fields is required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Curiosity and passion for Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Technical Requirements

  • Good programming skills in Python.
  • Familiarity with modern AI and Machine Learning concepts.
  • Basic knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, or Generative AI frameworks is considered a plus.
  • Knowledge of software development best practices and version control systems (Git) is a plus.
  • Interest in financial markets and quantitative finance is appreciated but not required.
  • Good knowledge of English is required.

Altre informazioni

The gross monthly salary is 1200 euros.

Diversity & Inclusion are core values for Mediobanca. All applications are welcome; we value age, background, ability, personal orientation and gender expression diversity.

Descrizione azienda

Mediobanca is an established, specialized financial operator operating in Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking and Consumer Finance, with an unparalleled reputation in the Italian market, consolidated by an acknowledged responsible approach to banking, the high professionalism of staff, and the excellence of the services offer.


Posizione

Mediobanca Spain is looking for candidates to start full time in June 2027 to join their Investment Banking (M&A) team based in Madrid.

About the position:

  • Full time Off-Cycle internship in the Investment Banking M&A Generalist team in Madrid
  • 6 month period

About Mediobanca:

  • Leading European Investment Bankwith a market capitalization of €22.5bn
  • Primary focus on Corporate & Investment Banking
    • Corporate finance advisory
    • Equity and debt capital markets
    • Lending
  • International network
    • Headquartered in Milan
    • Capital markets hub in London
    • Local origination and execution teams in Madrid, Paris and Frankfurt
  • Mediobanca Spain operational since 2008
    • Top 10 in the Spanish M&A ranking
    • Extensive track record across products and sectors

Requirements:

  • Strong interest in finance
  • Previous experience in finance related positions would be a plus
  • Advance level in using Microsoft Office with strong focus in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Fluency in Spanish and English


Altre informazioni

Diversity & Inclusion are core values for Mediobanca. All applications are welcome; we value age, background, ability, personal orientation and gender expression diversity.

title: Junior Analyst – Debt Division, DCM & Financing, Paris
description:
Descrizione azienda

Mediobanca is an established, specialized financial operator operating in Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking and Consumer Finance, with an unparalleled reputation in the Italian market, consolidated by an acknowledged responsible approach to banking, the high professionalism of staff, and the excellence of the services offer.


Posizione

Position

The Junior Analyst will work across a wide range of financing opportunities, including corporate lending, leveraged finance and infrastructure lending. As part of a growing team based in Paris, the successful candidate will contribute to live transactions from day one, working closely with senior bankers and gaining direct exposure to clients throughout the execution process.

Main tasks

  • Support public and private deal execution, liaising with clients, legal counsel and internal credit and risk functions
  • Build and maintain financial models
  • Prepare pitches, market updates and credit papers
  • Review debt documentation alongside senior bankers and external counsel
  • Contribute to day-to-day origination efforts, including the identification and preparation of new business opportunities
  • Work alongside the team's interns and help onboard them onto ongoing workstreams

Requisiti

Requirements

We are looking for a highly motivated and entrepreneurial candidate, eager to take on responsibility early and to gain exposure to senior bankers and clients on live transactions. The candidate should combine strong analytical and modelling skills with excellent oral and written communication and a high level of attention to detail.

One to two years of relevant experience in investment banking, private equity, debt advisory or audit is required, ideally with some exposure to transaction execution.

Fluency in English and French is required. A good command of Italian is considered a plus.


Altre informazioni

Diversity & Inclusion are core values for Mediobanca. All applications are welcome; we value age, background, ability, personal orientation and gender expression diversity.

title: Quantitative Credit Risk Modeller
description:
Descrizione azienda

Mediobanca is an established, specialized financial operator operating in Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking and Consumer Finance, with an unparalleled reputation in the Italian market, consolidated by an acknowledged responsible approach to banking, the high professionalism of staff, and the excellence of the services offer.


Posizione

Mediobanca is looking for an experienced Quantitative Credit Risk Modeller to join the Pillar 1 Credit Risk Methodologies team within the Risk Management Department. The role combines quantitative modelling, regulatory expertise and business impact, with direct involvement in the development, monitoring and evolution of internal credit risk models across multiple asset classes.

Role and Responsibilities:


·Develop, calibrate and monitor credit risk models and parameters across multiple asset classes, for regulatory and accounting purposes.

·Quantify RWA impacts arising from model changes, recalibrations, portfolio developments and regulatory scenarios, and present the underlying analyses to internal and external stakeholders.

·Monitor the models’ performance over time and create insightful reports.

·Collaborate with model development teams across other Group entities and contribute to the definition of common frameworks for cross-entity credit risk methodology topics.


Requisiti

·Experience: Approximately 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in leading financial institutions, fintech companies or consulting firms.

·Technical Expertise: Advanced SAS programming skills are required, proficiency in Python is strongly preferred.

·Regulatory Knowledge: Strong knowledge of the applicable credit risk regulatory framework, including CRR3, EBA Guidelines and the ECB Guide to Internal Models, together with familiarity with IFRS 9.

·Educational Background: Degree in a quantitative subject or in economics/finance with a strong quantitative background.

·Problem-Solving Skills: Problem solving aptitude, critical and logical thinking skills.

·Communication Skills: Ability to convey technical analyses clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

·Language Proficiency: Fluency in English (written and oral).


What We Offer:

Join a highly specialized team working on credit risk models with direct impact on capital requirements and risk management decisions. You will gain hands-on exposure across the full model lifecycle, tackle complex quantitative and regulatory challenges, and collaborate with senior stakeholders and teams across the Group. The role offers strong technical ownership, continuous learning and the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects within a growing banking group.


In line with Pay Transparency regulations, please be informed that the contract type envisaged for this role is a permanent contract, with a minimum gross annual salary of €38.395,38 and contractual classification Employee, Area III, Level II ("Impiegato, III Area, II Livello") under the national collective labour agreement for the banking/credit sector, in addition to which benefits and the possibility of accessing the incentive system apply, as provided for under the remuneration policies in force from time to time, which can be consulted on Mediobanca's website.


Altre informazioni

Diversity & Inclusion are core values for Mediobanca. All applications are welcome; we value age, background, ability, personal orientation and gender expression diversity.
